body.usage: Clean, highly legible for dense data arrays.

mono.usage: Crucial for JSON payloads, policy rules, agent IDs, and audit logs.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid muddy glass. Use solid surface_100 with 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle text-shadow or box-shadow with accent colors for 'Allow' or 'Block' badges.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Data heavy dashboards use subtle borders (border-white/10) to define areas without shadows.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight inner padding (p-4 to p-6) for cards, generous outer padding for page (p-8).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense data, right-align numbers/metrics.

components.cards: Flat background (surface_100), 1px border-white/10, no shadow. Hover: slight lift, border-white/20.
components.buttons: Primary: white background, black text. Secondary: surface_100 background, white text, 1px border-white/10.
components.badges: Translucent background (accent/10) + opaque text (accent). Example: bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400.
components.inputs: surface_100 background, border-white/10. Focus: ring-1 ring-white/20.

motion.live_feed: Use framer-motion to slide in new decisions in the Runtime Decision Engine feed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Dark mode text should be off-white (#E5E7EB) not pure white to reduce astigmatism glare.
accessibility.focus: Mandatory focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/20).

image_urls.description: Dark abstract textile/mesh texture for the auth page background.
OpenAI logo for AI Agent integration.
Professional avatar for the top right profile dropdown.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next-level Enterprise Dashboard with React and Tailwind CSS for .js files.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React for all icons, keeping a minimal technical aesthetic.
Ensure 'Runtime Decision Engine' includes a live streaming feed (simulated with setTimeout or setInterval) that displays Allow/Block decisions sliding in.
For the 'Policy Builder', implement a clean visual rule composer using a stacked card layout.
Include a 'Traffic Simulator' button that injects 5-10 fake requests to populate the feed and update KPI charts.
Do NOT use HTML native date/select. Use Shadcn UI logic but style it heavily according to these dark-mode guidelines.
Charts (Recharts): Use dark theme tooltips, remove cartesian grid lines or make them highly transparent (stroke='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'), use thin bright lines.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to separate components instead of shadows, which disappear in dark mode.
Never center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, and entrance animations.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all key elements for testing.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating elements. Use a solid background (`#111`) with a border (`border-white/10`).
